SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date 
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT store_sales.ss_customer_sk, date_dim.d_date AS d_date_store 
        FROM store_sales 
        JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
        WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
    ) AS store 
    JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk, date_dim.d_date AS d_date_catalog 
        FROM catalog_sales 
        JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
        WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
    ) AS catalog 
    ON store.ss_customer_sk = catalog.cs_bill_customer_sk 
    AND store.d_date_store = catalog.d_date_catalog 
    JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk, date_dim.d_date AS d_date_web 
        FROM web_sales 
        JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
        WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
    ) AS web 
    ON store.ss_customer_sk = web.ws_bill_customer_sk 
    AND store.d_date_store = web.d_date_web 
    JOIN customer ON store.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk 
    LIMIT 100
) AS hot_cust LIMIT 100
